item.title: UN condemns US embargo of Cuba, but more nations sit out after Trump pressure
item.description: The UN General Assembly condemned the US economic embargo of Cuba for the 34th year on Wednesday, even as Washington’s campaign to influence the outcome led to a number of countries voting against the resolution or sitting out the decision for the first time. The vote was 130-17, with 25 abstentions – a notable decrease in support from last year, when more than 160 nations supported the measure and only 12 abstained. item.title: Bolsonaro's escape to the US: How it happened
item.description: Brazil's defeated right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro arrived in Florida by private plane Wednesday after fleeing his country in defiance of a court order to surrender his passport. Bolsonaro, who lost a runoff election to incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Sunday, is under investigation in Brazil for alleged corruption and money laundering and, with his defeat, is set to lose parliamentary immunity. FRANCE 24's international affairs editor Kethevane Gorjestani explains. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Murió Alvin Hellerstein, el juez estadounidense que presidía el caso contra Nicolás Maduro
item.description: Tenía 92 años. El inicio del juicio oral contra Maduro y su esposa está previsto para junio de 2027, después de algunas dilaciones. Con el fallecimiento del magistrado, la fecha podría volver a cambiar. Publicado también por: Clarín - Mundo. Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.
